title: Ceramic Blue Tile
description: Premium ceramic tile with a luxurious blue glaze finish designed to enhance both modern and classic interiors. This high-quality ceramic tile is manufactured using advanced heating and finishing technology to ensure excellent durability, long-lasting color retention, and superior resistance against moisture, stains, and scratches. The elegant glossy surface reflects light beautifully, making rooms appear brighter, cleaner, and more spacious. It is ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, living rooms, office spaces, restaurants, hotels, and commercial environments. The smooth texture allows for easy cleaning and low maintenance, while the strong ceramic body provides reliable performance even in high-traffic areas. Its stylish blue appearance blends perfectly with contemporary interior designs and decorative wall patterns.

title: Marble White Tile
description: Elegant white marble tile crafted for luxurious and modern interior decoration projects. The polished marble-inspired surface creates a premium and sophisticated atmosphere suitable for residential homes, office interiors, hotel lobbies, shopping malls, and luxury commercial spaces. Its bright white finish reflects natural and artificial light effectively, helping rooms feel more open, fresh, and elegant. Manufactured with high-quality materials, this tile offers impressive strength, stain resistance, and durability for long-term usage. The smooth finish also makes cleaning and maintenance extremely simple. This tile works beautifully for both flooring and wall applications and pairs perfectly with gold, silver, wooden, or minimalist decorative elements.

title: Wooden Brown Tile
description: Wood-style porcelain tile featuring a realistic natural wood texture and warm brown finish that creates a cozy and elegant environment. Designed to combine the natural beauty of wood with the durability of porcelain, this tile is resistant to water, scratches, fading, and heavy foot traffic. It is ideal for bedrooms, living rooms, restaurants, offices, cafés, and commercial spaces where a natural wooden appearance is desired without the maintenance challenges of real wood flooring. The detailed grain texture gives an authentic wooden feel while maintaining the long-lasting performance of premium porcelain material. Its slim rectangular shape adds a stylish and modern look to floors and walls.

title: Glossy Black Tile
description: Shiny black granite tile designed for luxury flooring and modern interior decoration. Its reflective glossy surface adds depth, elegance, and a premium look to any space. Ideal for living rooms, hotels, restaurants, showrooms, and high-end commercial environments. This tile is highly durable, scratch-resistant, and easy to clean, making it suitable for heavy usage areas while maintaining a stylish appearance.

title: Rustic Stone Tile
description: Natural rustic stone tile designed for outdoor and indoor use, offering a rough textured finish that enhances grip and durability. Perfect for patios, gardens, walkways, and exterior walls. It provides a natural earthy look while ensuring long-lasting performance under different weather conditions. Its strong structure makes it resistant to wear, moisture, and temperature changes.

title: Mosaic Green Tile
description: Decorative mosaic green tile featuring artistic patterns designed for stylish interior decoration. Perfect for bathroom walls, kitchen backsplashes, swimming pools, and feature walls. The small patterned pieces create a unique artistic effect that enhances visual appeal and adds a vibrant touch to any space. Made from high-quality glass material for durability and shine.

title: Matte Grey Tile
description: Modern matte grey ceramic tile designed for minimalist and industrial interior styles. Its smooth matte finish provides a soft and elegant look while reducing glare. Highly durable and stain-resistant, making it ideal for both residential and commercial spaces such as kitchens, bathrooms, and offices.

title: Luxury Gold Tile
description: Premium luxury gold tile with a textured finish designed for high-end interior decoration. Its golden shine creates a rich and elegant atmosphere suitable for hotels, luxury homes, showrooms, and feature walls. Durable and stylish, it enhances any space with a royal aesthetic.

title: Outdoor Cement Tile
description: Strong cement tile designed for outdoor environments such as patios, rooftops, driveways, and walkways. Built for durability and anti-slip performance, it withstands heavy usage and harsh weather conditions while maintaining a solid and natural appearance.

title: Patterned Vintage Tile
description: Vintage patterned ceramic tile inspired by traditional designs, perfect for adding artistic and cultural aesthetics to interiors. Suitable for kitchens, cafés, feature walls, and decorative flooring. It brings a classic timeless charm with detailed patterns and colors.

title: Sky Blue Porcelain Tile
description: Elegant sky blue porcelain tile with a smooth finish designed to create a calm and refreshing environment. Ideal for bathrooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and modern interior designs. Its soft color tone enhances brightness and gives a clean aesthetic look.

title: Textured Beige Tile
description: Neutral beige ceramic tile with a textured anti-slip surface designed for safety and elegance. Perfect for both indoor and outdoor use, including kitchens, bathrooms, hallways, and patios. Its soft color blends well with any interior design style.
